sources.title: Fanon's own major works, Black Skin, White Masks (1952) and The Wretched of the Earth (1961), and his open letter to Robert Lacoste (1956)
"Frantz Fanon in Algiers" (Verso Books) -- documents his Blida-Joinville deportation, the Lacoste letter, and his diplomatic roles with named dates
"Frantz Fanon's Radical Approach to Psychiatry and Psychotherapy" -- documents his specific institutional reforms at Blida-Joinville Psychiatric Hospital

independent_thinking.rationale: Two independent documented instances: publicly resigned his hospital directorship in colonial Algeria via an open letter to Resident General Robert Lacoste directly denouncing French colonial psychiatric practice (1956), an act that led directly to his deportation from the country; and synthesized clinical psychiatry, political economy, and philosophy into an original theoretical framework departing sharply from prevailing colonial-psychiatric orthodoxy.

risk_tolerance.rationale: Multiple independent documented instances spanning nearly two decades: enlisted with the Free French Forces at 18, was wounded in the Battle for Colmar (1944) and received the Croix de Guerre for bravery; issued a public letter of denunciation against colonial authority that led directly to his own deportation (1956); and survived two separate assassination attempts as an FLN representative -- a car bomb (which killed a nearby child instead) and a separate attempt in Libya.

leadership_drive.rationale: Multiple independent documented leadership roles across distinct domains: head of the Fifth Ward at Blida-Joinville Psychiatric Hospital, where he led institutional reform (1953-1956); head of the Algerian delegation to the All-African People's Conference in Accra (December 1958); Algeria's first ambassador to Ghana (1959); and the FLN's itinerant permanent representative across multiple countries (Accra, Conakry, Addis Ababa, Leopoldville, Cairo, Tripoli) from 1960.

conflict_tolerance.rationale: Two independent, well-documented confrontational episodes: direct public denunciation of the highest colonial authority in Algeria at severe personal and professional cost (deportation, 1956); and institutional reforms at Blida-Joinville that directly challenged the hospital's entrenched colonial hierarchies, which segregated patients by ethnicity, against internal institutional resistance.

systems_abstraction.rationale: Two independent instances of systems-level integration: The Wretched of the Earth (1961) integrates clinical case material, political economy, and philosophy of violence into a single coherent theory of decolonization; and his institutional-reform program at Blida (daily patient meetings, a library, ergotherapy stations, patient sports, and a co-produced patient newspaper) was organized as one coherent resocialization system rather than ad hoc interventions.

cross_domain_range.rationale: Sustained active, independently-verifiable work across at least four distinct domains during overlapping periods, not sequential career stages: clinical psychiatric practice, institutional/organizational reform, published political-philosophical theory (two major books), and formal diplomatic/ambassadorial representation for the FLN.

resourcefulness.rationale: Built a full functioning therapeutic ecosystem -- a library, multiple ergotherapy stations (weaving, pottery, knitting, gardening), a patient sports program, and a co-produced in-house newspaper -- at an under-resourced, colonial-era hospital specifically to work around its entrenched institutional limitations, inferred from the documented convergence of these several distinct, concrete interventions.

achievement_drive.rationale: Sustained a full clinical practice, produced two major independently influential books, and held a formal diplomatic/ambassadorial role simultaneously, within a career cut short by his death at 36, inferred as exceptional achievement drive from the documented density of concrete, independently-verifiable roles held in parallel rather than sequence.

proactive_agency.rationale: Voluntarily left a stable, established hospital directorship to work directly with, and eventually formally represent internationally, an active independence movement -- documented via the deliberate, self-initiated nature of both the 1956 resignation and the subsequent diplomatic role, which extended well beyond his original medical role boundaries.

persuasiveness.rationale: Secured de facto diplomatic recognition from Ghana despite lacking formal diplomatic status, engaged directly with multiple independent liberation leaders (Patrice Lumumba, Holden Roberto, Felix Moumie) at the 1958 Accra conference, and worked specifically to win over Independent African States to press Algeria's case at the United Nations -- inferred as real persuasive skill from this documented convergence of international political engagement.

collaboration.rationale: Notre Journal, the in-house hospital newspaper he established, was explicitly co-produced by patients, staff, and physicians together, a single documented instance of deliberately structuring a collaborative rather than top-down intervention.

provenance.notes: Roster-1000 session 13 (source-grounded research-depth control): re-researched from session 12's original 3-source, 6-row profile using genuinely inspected substantive sources, including a scholarly Verso Books account naming specific dates for his deportation and diplomatic roles, and a clinical-history source documenting the specific programmatic content of his Blida-Joinville reforms. A factual evidence ledger (15 distinct episodes) was built and locked before any trait score was assigned; NEW_EVIDENCE per docs/scoring-rubric-v1.md Sec.10. Two assassination-attempt survivals and his WWII combat wound/Croix de Guerre, absent from the original profile entirely, are the single largest new evidentiary contribution and are the primary basis for the risk_tolerance row. Several plausible additional rows (adaptability, curiosity) were deliberately NOT added because their strongest supporting facts were already used for a better-fitting row above (chiefly cross_domain_range).
